integrity: The finite counting proof is supported by a standalone standard-library script that exhausts the specified normalized and labeled cases; no authorship or outside validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three agents, three houses, complete strict orders and uniform profiles; the separate two-agent minimality argument does not establish results for larger electorates. The literature may contain uncatalogued equivalent small-market classifications.
title: A half-law for Pareto-inefficient top cycles in three-agent house assignment
